description: A query from the reconstruction reads the original span [1, 3). Inside it, initial, from and after use that span's own bounds in original positions: $f starts the span, from($f) is "b c", and after($f) is C (engine §7.6).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [T] $x(pair)
%conditions matches($x, q)
%rule b A [T] [T] pair
%rule c A T pair
%rule pair B C
%rule q $f(B) C
%conditions initial($f), text(from($f)) = "b c", matches(after($f), cc)
%rule cc C
